correctness.rationale: Reconstructed starting at a renewal epoch: Azuma bounds ensure finite E[N] for finite signed marks of positive stationary drift. Conditional variance decomposition with M=sum stopped edge means and V=sum stopped edge variances gives Var(H)=Var(M)+EV. For g_ij=v_ij-B mu_ij the centered Poisson equation (I-P)h=E_j[g_ij|i] gives E sum_{m<=N}g=E[h(J0)-h(JN)] by bounded-increment optional stopping. Hence exact identity VarH-B EH=Var(M)+E[h(J0)-h(JN)] and universal additive bound. At alpha=mu, overshoot U in [0,mu_max) forces VarM<=mu_max^2/4 and EH=k+O(1). For alpha=c mu+b_i-b_j, bounded endpoint potential again bounds M-k/c, giving same asymptotic coefficient; single-state renewal demonstrates sharpness. Separately reconstructed finite Poisson and crossing moments with 24 exact rational cases in independent_checks.py.
residual_risks: The finite 24-case verification is not a proof of uniformity in all edge markings; uniformity rests on the Poisson corrector proof.
No stationarity-at-arbitrary-age, non-finite-state, non-independent holding-time, infinite variance, or zero/negative mean-flux claim.
